# laravelforge_site_octane (Data Source)

Fetches the Laravel Octane integration status of a Laravel Forge site (singleton per site).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site whose Octane integration is fetched.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (String) Whether the Octane integration is enabled, as reported by Forge.
- `octane_installed` (Boolean) Whether the Octane package is installed on the site.
- `port` (Number) Port Octane is configured to listen on, as reported by Forge.
